Instructions: SETUP: the 1.2 mm insert's Cd test again, AFTER the pin-gauge check (docs/ORIFICE_CD_TEST.md; about 10 min plus the check). Why: it read Cd 0.527 (2026-10-15) and 0.547 after cleaning (2026-10-22), i.e. it passes gas like a ~0.97 mm bore, while the 0.5 / 0.8 mm inserts read 0.84 / 0.81 through the same line. FIRST, the bore check, with the insert out: 1.20 mm pin from the INLET end and from the TIP end, each through the full 7.5 mm (a pin that stops part-way means a stepped or undersize drilling); then the next size down and up (e.g. 1.19 go, 1.21 no-go) to bracket the real diameter; look at the tip edge for a burr. Tell Claude the sizes that go / do not go from each end. If the bore is undersize or stepped: STOP here, re-make the insert and run this row on the new one. If it passes: refit it. Nozzle card: Orifice 1.2, Orifice length box 7.5 (unless the re-made insert differs). No silicone: EMPTY or DISCONNECT the silicone line; Speed 0, RPM empty. Purge the nozzle dry (6,000 sccm for 30 s). START, then step the gas with Set Flow: 2,000 -> 4,000 -> 6,000 -> 8,000 -> 10,000 -> 12,000 sccm, about 20 s each. STOP EVERYTHING to end. The camera is not needed. Check the pressure at each step against a good bore (Cd 0.8): 1.02 / 1.04 / 1.08 / 1.14 / 1.21 / 1.29 barA. The last two tests read 1.03 / 1.10 / 1.19 / 1.31 / 1.47 / 1.64 (10-15) and 1.02 / 1.08 / 1.17 / 1.29 / 1.43 / 1.61 (10-22). If it reads ~1.6 at 12,000 again, run the next row.

OPTIONAL, run it if the 1.2 mm still reads ~1.6 barA at 12,000 sccm (on the 2026-10-22 sheet but not captured). The LINE-LOSS run (docs/ORIFICE_CD_TEST.md step 4): checks whether pressure lost in the line and bubbler between the Alicat and the exit is what makes the 1.2 mm read low. Take the insert OUT: the bare 1.8 mm bubbler exit. Nozzle card: Orifice 1.8, Orifice length box 7.5 (not used for this run). No silicone: Speed 0, RPM empty. Purge 6,000 sccm for 30 s. START, then step the gas with Set Flow: 2,000 -> 4,000 -> 6,000 -> 8,000 -> 10,000 -> 12,000 sccm, about 20 s each. STOP EVERYTHING to end. The camera is not needed. Note the pressure at 12,000 sccm: a clean line reads ~1.07 barA; ~1.3 or more means the line, not the insert, is eating the 1.2 mm's pressure.
